title: Veterans Pension Retroactive Releases — Monthly Disability Compensation Paid for Months of Pension
content:
# Monthly Disability Compensation subtracted from a Veterans Pension retroactive release

Monthly compensation paid for months of pension is subtracted from a retroactive Veterans Pension release. What is subtracted depends on the veteran's Disability Compensation award — whether it ended by his election of pension or is still running — and on the monthly compensation payments in its payment ledger:

1. When the Disability Compensation award ended by the veteran's election of pension, all monthly compensation issued in the whole months since the pension effective date is subtracted.
2. When the Disability Compensation award is still running, the monthly compensation issued in the months owed is subtracted.
3. Otherwise nothing is subtracted.

| Disability Compensation award | Monthly compensation subtracted |
|---|---|
| ended by election of pension, monthly payments issued since the pension effective date | all of them |
| running, monthly payments issued in the months owed | those payments |
| any other position, or no such payments | 0 |

## Hypothetical cases

- Pension effective 10 whole months ago; the compensation award ended by election of pension and issued 4 monthly payments of 800.00 in those 10 months: 3200.00 is subtracted, even if only 3 months are owed.
- Compensation award running; 3 months owed, in which 2 monthly payments of 800.00 were issued: 1600.00 is subtracted.
- Compensation award terminated for a reason other than election of pension: nothing is subtracted.
